## `authValidateAccessToken`

**GET** `/identity/v2/auth/access_token/validate`

Validate Access Token

Validates an Access Token, returning its expiry if valid, or an error if invalid.

### Example

```typescript
async function callAuthValidateAccessToken(client: LoginRadius) {
  const access_token: string = '<access_token>'; //Optional

  try {
    const res = await client.<service>.authValidateAccessToken({ access_token });
    console.log(res.data);
  } catch (err) {
    if (err instanceof LoginRadiusError) {
      console.error(err.description);
    } else {
      throw err;
    }
  }
}
```

### Parameters

| Name | In | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `access_token` | query | string | no | Access Token of the User |

### Returns

`AccessTokenResponse`

## `invalidateAccessToken`

**GET** `/identity/v2/auth/access_token/invalidate`

Invalidate Access Token

Invalidates an active Access Token, expiring its validity.

### Example

```typescript
async function callInvalidateAccessToken(client: LoginRadius) {
  const preventRefresh: string = '<preventRefresh>'; //Optional

  try {
    const res = await client.<service>.invalidateAccessToken({ preventRefresh });
    console.log(res.data);
  } catch (err) {
    if (err instanceof LoginRadiusError) {
      console.error(err.description);
    } else {
      throw err;
    }
  }
}
```

### Parameters

| Name | In | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `preventRefresh` | query | boolean | no | Whether to prevent the token from being refreshed (true/false). |

### Returns

`IsPostedResponse`
